visual_history.assessment:
- Missing parts: The gas burner grates are completely missing from the top of the oven because they were placed at Z=0 instead of on the cooktop surface.
- Wrong proportions/colors: The body color is too light (white) rather than a gray stone-textured metallic finish.
- Misalignment: Burner components need to be shifted up to the cooktop height (~0.87).

- The body color is far too light, appearing almost white instead of gray stone-textured metallic.
- The digital clock "12:01" display is nearly invisible due to size and lack of contrast.
- The black glass cooktop doesn't stand out enough from the main chassis.
